rubrics.justification: The response fabricates classic 3AA blastocyst features (expanded cavity, clear ICM, cohesive TE, thinning zona) despite repeatedly noting the image appears more like a single cell/oocyte and not a clear blastocyst.
It integrates age, AMH, prior IVF failures, sperm quality, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality reasonably well, though some claims are overstated.

The reasoning is internally inconsistent: it repeatedly identifies a major image-text mismatch, then ignores it and concludes the image supports a 3AA blastocyst. Probability reasoning is only partly supported.

General counseling on embryo quality, lifestyle optimization, and proceeding with transfer is broadly aligned, but recommending PGT-A strongly for DOR/history and suggesting RIF workup after this history are somewhat overstated and not fully guideline-grounded.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle modification, luteal support consideration, and future-cycle planning, though some recommendations lack nuance and depend on uncertain assumptions.
